text: dsh-plugin-module-driven-dev 是 DSH 的模块驱动开发技能。它注册包内 Markdown 技能 provider，指导主 agent 拆解需求、编写模块设计，并协调独立子 agent 生成和集成代码；设计变更按新设计重生成，需求变更递归传递。适合以多 agent 流程开发软件的用户，无需额外 API Key。

dsh-plugin-module-driven-dev adds a DSH skill for modular software development. It discovers bundled Markdown skills that guide a main agent to split requirements, document designs, and coordinate sub-agents to generate code. Design changes trigger regeneration. No API key is needed.
想让 DSH 把大型开发需求拆成可分工的模块。
希望多个子 agent 各自实现模块，再由主 agent 集成。

dsh-plugin-module-driven-dev 的功能「递归拆解需求」：主 agent 将需求逐层拆成职责清楚、依赖明确的模块。 由开发流程中的需求拆解、设计或变更触发，输入需求或设计，输出模块任务与实现。
dsh-plugin-module-driven-dev 的功能「设计驱动生成」：叶子模块由独立子 agent 按设计文档生成代码。 由开发流程中的需求拆解、设计或变更触发，输入需求或设计，输出模块任务与实现。
dsh-plugin-module-driven-dev 的功能「协调多 agent 实现」：主 agent 按依赖顺序派发任务并集成模块结果。 由开发流程中的需求拆解、设计或变更触发，输入需求或设计，输出模块任务与实现。
dsh-plugin-module-driven-dev 的功能「设计变更后重生成」：设计修订后归档旧代码并按新版设计重生成。 由开发流程中的需求拆解、设计或变更触发，输入需求或设计，输出模块任务与实现。
dsh-plugin-module-driven-dev 的功能「递归传播需求变更」：分析受影响模块，并递归决定是否向下派单。 由开发流程中的需求拆解、设计或变更触发，输入需求或设计，输出模块任务与实现。
我想让需求调整能追踪依赖关系并安排受影响模块重新设计。

dsh-plugin-module-driven-dev README · 🧩 dsh-plugin-module-driven-dev：**Module-Driven Development (MDD) plugin for DeepSeek Harness**

Decompose any requirement into a module tree, let each module be designed and generated by an **independent agent**, have the **main agent orchestrate, integrate and debug**, and **fully regenerate from design** whenever a design or requirement changes.

dsh-plugin-module-driven-dev README · ✨ Features：| # | Feature | How it works |
|---|---------|--------------|
| 1 | **A programming plugin** | A skill-driven software development protocol covering decomposition, design, implementation, integration, debugging and change management. |
| 2 | **Recursive requirement decomposition** | Requirements → modules → submodules, decomposed level by level until every leaf module is small enough for a single agent to design *and* implement independently (termination rules in [`references/decomposition.md`](skills/module-driven-dev/references/decomposition.md)). |
| 3 | **Independent agents generate code** | Each leaf module is fully generated by its own sub-agent; a module with submodules acts as the next-level main agent and dispatches recursively. The main agent orchestrates, integrates and debugs ([`references/agent-protocol.md`](skills/module-driven-dev/references/agent-protocol.md)). |
| 4 | **Design change ⇒ full code regeneration** | The design document is the single source of truth. Bumping its revision archives the old code, wipes the module directory, and regenerates *everything* from the new design — patching old code is forbidden. |

| `api/routes` | `authsvc_api` | FastAPI HTTP layer: routes, DI, unified error handling |

dsh-plugin-module-driven-dev README · 🚀 Usage：- **"用模块驱动开发实现 \<requirement\>"** → main agent runs P0–P5: decompose the module tree (`.mdd/manifest.md`) → design each module (`.mdd/designs/`) → dispatch independent sub-agents to generate code (`.mdd/code/`) → integrate, build, debug.
- **"把 \<module\> 的设计改成 …"** → design change: revision +1, archive old code, regenerate everything from the new design.
- **"需求调整：\<new requirement\>"** → a change-analyst sub-agent locates the affected modules (including propagation along the dependency graph), module agents recursively decide whether to push the task further down, then redesign + regenerate + re-integrate.

dsh-plugin-module-driven-dev README · 🧠 How it works：```
dsh-plugin-module-driven-dev        ← Cordis bundle (patch layer, not executed itself)
  └─ cordis.patch.yml inserts one row:
       skill-mdd-provider            ← loader entry (id)
         name: dsh-plugin-module-driven-dev

The skill is the product; the provider row is the infrastructure that makes it discoverable.

dsh-plugin-module-driven-dev README · 📁 Project structure：```
dsh-plugin-module-driven-develop/
├── index.js                 # Self-contained skill provider (portable, no absolute paths)
├── cordis.patch.yml         # Bundle patch: mounts index.js into the host composition
├── package.json             # Bundle metadata (dsh.bundle.patch)

dsh-plugin-module-driven-dev README · 🛠 Development：```powershell
npm pack                                        # Build the distributable tarball
node test-provider.mjs                          # Verify the skill provider (discovery + load)
.\scripts\install.ps1 -Scope Project            # Install the skill for local testing
```

The provider is deliberately dependency-free: no runtime imports beyond Node built-ins, so the bundle installs anywhere.
